caption: The video captures a close-up CNC machining scene against a dark, softly lit background veiled in persistent hazy mist. An angled black spindle head with a metallic tool holder and a slender end mill occupies the upper left, its tip pressed into the left side of a machined metal part. The workpiece is a polished cylindrical block whose top is sculpted into curved, swept turbine-like blades rising from a shiny base at the lower right. Initially the cutter stays engaged, sliding laterally along the upper edge of the blades as the spindle shifts position. The bladed structure and base remain a continuous solid object, and no deformation or material removal is visible. As the process continues the tool lifts and pulls away, opening a clear air gap between the cutter tip and the top of the blades. The misty haze and dark gradient persist with subtle brightness shifts, while the relative positions of the spindle and workpiece change. The ongoing traversal gives way to a retraction.
relations: While the end mill tip stays pressed against the blade edge, lateral spindle movement slides it along the upper contour.
As the spindle retracts upward, the cutter tip pulls away, opening a clear air gap above the blades.
The bladed workpiece remains a continuous polished cylinder, with no visible deformation or material removal during traversal.
Hazy mist and dark gradient persist around the spindle and workpiece as their relative positions shift.
